seq.title: Cleaning supply check
seq.body: Labelled safe supplies → gloves and cloths → organized caddy. Overlay: “Know your materials before a reset.”. CTA: [one factual next step].

seq.title: Entry reset
seq.body: Clear entry shelf → sort keys and shoes → tidy landing tray. Overlay: “Start where clutter enters.”. CTA: [one factual next step].

seq.title: Laundry sort
seq.body: Empty baskets → fabric-care label → separated piles. Overlay: “Read the label first.”. CTA: [one factual next step].

seq.title: Bed linen refresh
seq.body: Folded clean linens → fitted-sheet corner → finished bed. Overlay: “One reset that helps a room feel ready.”. CTA: [one factual next step].

seq.title: Kitchen counter workflow
seq.body: Empty work surface → labeled tools → orderly finished surface. Overlay: “Make the sequence visible.”. CTA: [one factual next step].

seq.title: Pantry zones

seq.title: Closet edit

seq.title: Supply refill

seq.title: Weekly business review
seq.body: Anonymized figures → quote status columns → weekly next-actions. Overlay: “Count paid work separately from inquiries.”. CTA: [one factual next step].

tp.title: Three-step practical tip
tp.body: 0–3s: “A calmer pantry starts here” | 3–8s: “Group by use” | 8–13s: “Label only what helps” | 13–18s: “Want a scoped organizing quote?”. Visual: Show hands organizing your own pantry; no narration needed.

tp.title: Before / process / after
tp.body: 0–3s: “One shelf, three stages” | 3–8s: “Before (used with permission)” | 8–13s: “Sorting and resetting” | 13–18s: “After — ask how our service works”. Visual: Do not imply the example is a real customer result unless it is.

tp.title: Service scope explainer
tp.body: 0–4s: “What is in a [service] visit?” | 4–9s: “[included step one]” | 9–14s: “[included step two]” | 14–20s: “Ask for the full scope at [link]”. Visual: Only include deliverables your business actually offers.

tp.title: Myth versus careful fact
tp.body: 0–4s: “Myth: [common assumption]” | 4–10s: “Reality: [verified qualification]” | 10–16s: “Check [manufacturer/professional guidance]” | 16–21s: “Save this reminder”. Visual: Never turn unverified household safety claims into a tip.

tp.title: A quick process checklist
tp.body: 0–4s: “Before [task], check these three things” | 4–9s: “1. [check]” | 9–14s: “2. [check]” | 14–19s: “3. [check]” | 19–23s: “Need help? [real booking route]”. Visual: Film staged or permission-based shots, not private records. SOUND + ACCESSIBILITY Original silent footage works. If adding audio, use music you are permitted to use; trending audio is optional, not a requirement. Keep captions readable and avoid flicker.
